revision_contract.owner: Codex (What Changed fixture/spec). This manifest only fixes the shared vocabulary and anchors.
rules: A revision of Contract A keeps every clause heading and ordinal, so persisted clauses and evidence anchors stay comparable.
A revision changes facts only by editing the wording of the fact `text` listed in this manifest; every other sentence stays byte-identical.
Facts listed in no_change_control_fact_keys must not change and must not be reported as changed (NO_CHANGE controls).
A revision must keep all six categories PRESENT unless it declares an explicit expected_health override, proven by the backend conformance test.
A revision manifest reuses this schema, fixture vocabulary and category names; it must not introduce parallel category or change-cause names.
